text:
anya: Morning team — quick async pulse for the sprint. Post 1) what you did yesterday, 2) blockers, 3) plan for today. Focus: roadmap checkpoints + spec clarifications for the v2 routing work.

maria: 1) finished the model routing doc PR, added fallback examples. 2) need a decision on cost-tier routing thresholds (low/med/high). 3) will pair with kevin later to wire config UI.

jon: 1) landed end-to-end test for prefix caching. 2) blocked on failing integ tests from CI (flaky on long seq). 3) triaging tests and will open a draft fix PR this afternoon.

kevin: 1) looked at the UI mock and started the config form. 2) blocked on the API shape (how we represent routing tiers). 3) propose we reuse the existing "policy" object shape; pinged oliver for confirmation.

oliver: Confirmed reusing policy shape is fine, but we should add an explicit "cost_threshold" field. I'll add a note in the spec with examples for 3 buckets.

anya: Good — maria, can you update the PR with example thresholds Oliver suggested? No need to bikeshed numbers now, we can tune after telemetry. :+1:

maria: Yep will update in the next hour.

samantha: 1) ran a quick perf sweep on dedicated pool with quantized models. 2) saw 8-12% latency regression at 2k token sequences. 3) will reproduce with the newer kernel and file a bug if it persists.

jon: @samantha can you drop the failing test output here? I suspect it's the KV cache eviction path.

ci-bot: Build 7234 finished — 1 failing integ test: tests.integration.test_long_sequences::test_cache_stability (flaky). Logs: https://ci.internal/7234/logs

kevin: For the API shape, suggestion: keep it simple for now: { "policy_id": "string", "cost_threshold": number, "fallback_model": "string?" } — that will map cleanly to UI and runtime.

anya: Makes sense. We should also include a field for "rollout_strategy": [canary|all|gradual]. Add to spec if you think it's needed.

oliver: Adding rollout_strategy to the spec. For canary, we'll expose percentage and duration.

maria: PR updated with cost_threshold examples and rollout_strategy. Also added a short note about telemetry events (policy_applied, policy_fallback).

kevin: UI notes: will add a small help tooltip for cost_threshold that links to docs. ETA EOD.

jon: Pushed a fix attempt for the integ test — runs green locally. Opening PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/987. Can reviewers look today?

anya: I'll review. If green, let's unblock the release candidate.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging -> tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Manual approval required for prod.

anya: Quick prioritization call: do we want to keep reranker improvements in this sprint or move to next? Impact low for launch; propose move to next to reduce launch risk.

oliver: Agree — move reranker to next sprint. Update roadmap ticket.

maria: Moving reranker ticket (T-432) to next sprint now.

anya: Great. Last asks: reviewers on jon's PR, kevin/maria coordinate on API/UI, samantha to follow up on perf regression with kernel team. Ping me if anything blocks the RC. Cheers.
